notes.blurb: The court's ring and the palace, the brightest end of the axis: vermilion walls and gold-yellow roof tiles on white stone terraces.
notes.construction: Red (mangrove) walls between dark posts on pale diorite footings; a white second stone among the red.
notes.ground: White paving where the ground is made.
notes.roofs: Yellow (bamboo) tile, the nearest Minecraft stair-and-slab family to glazed gold-yellow: 'gold-yellow ones were reserved for nobility, temples, the Palace' (claim/roof-colour-by-rank). Irimoya, upturned eaves, the civic halls in two tiers.
notes.signature: Yellow roofs over red walls on white terraces, the one gold thing in the city.
